methods.what: Curve given by a sum of square roots, rationalised by squaring
Linear constraints on six variables, combined to eliminate z and zeta
Linear parametrisation of y and eta in terms of x, xi and t
Expansion of z·zeta after substituting z = t−x−y
Resulting quartic relation in x, y, xi, eta, t
Special case t=0, which gives a perfect square
Special case x=0, which gives a quadratic form in t and xi
Special case xi=0, which gives a quadratic form in t and x
